working_definition: Author type 'LC16' of the Özel et al. 2021 optic lobe atlas (Supplementary Table 1).

best_match.fbbt_definition: Immature form of a lobula columnar neuron (Konstantinides et al., 2022).

justification: 'LC16' is FBbt:00111751 'lobula columnar neuron LC16', which has no immature form in FBbt; at P15-P40 the cells are developing (curator: immature terms up to the pupal stage), so the most specific ancestor with an immature form is used: FBbt:00053273 'immature lobula columnar neuron' (as for Kurmangaliyev 2020 early clusters).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Lobula columnar neuron whose cell body lies in the ventral area of the lateral cell body rind (Wu et al., 2016). It has its main dendritic arbors in lobula layers 3-5B, with most synapses in layer 5B (Wu et al., 2016; Tanaka and Clark, 2022). Presynaptic sites are observed in layers 4 and 5B (Wu et al., 2016). Its arbors span approximately 30 optic columns, overlapping with other LC16 cells (Wu et al., 2016). It projects to a dorsal optic glomerulus of the PVLP (Wu et al., 2016). There are around 96 cells of this type (Wu et al., 2016). They are cholinergic (Davis et al., 2020).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Mature form, used from the pharate adult stage; no immature form in FBbt.

recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053273 'immature lobula columnar neuron' (broad match).
